The most recent sources point to **Next.js 16.4.2** as the latest stable release, though some sites lag behind.

- **npm (most current):** The npm registry lists 16.4.2 as the version under the "latest" tag, published about a day before the page was captured. Latest version: 16.4.2, last published: a day ago.
- **Release-tracking sites (older):** A changelog aggregator names 16.4.1 as the latest stable, with security fixes for several advisories. Latest stable v16.4.1 Versio also lists 16.4.1 as its latest version, dated 15 October 2026.
- **Earlier releases:** Versionlog lists 16.4.0 as released 06 Oct 2026, so it predates the 16.4.1 and 16.4.2 patches.

Bottom line: 16.4.2 is the newest version I found, per npm. The third-party trackers may simply not have updated yet. The official source to confirm is nextjs.org or `npm show next version`.

content.text:
The latest stable Next.js I found is **16.4.2**. I couldn't find its release date. The npm page only says it was published "a day ago", which would make it about 15 October 2026, but that's an inference.

- **16.4.0:** Versionlog lists it as released on 6 October 2026.
- **16.4.1:** Versio lists it as the latest version, dated 15 October 2026. It includes security fixes for several advisories.
- **16.4.2:** npm shows it under the "latest" tag. The third-party trackers may not have caught up to it yet.

To confirm the version and its exact date, run `npm show next version` and `npm show next time --json`, or check nextjs.org.

Sources:
- [next - npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/next)
- [next - npm versions](https://www.npmjs.com/package/next?activeTab=versions)
- [Next.js Latest Version - Release History, LTS & EOL (Versionlog)](https://versionlog.com/nextjs/)
- [Vercel Next.js releases, versions & EOL dates (Versio)](https://www.versio.io/en/product-release-end-of-life-eol-vercel-nextjs.html)
- [Next.js Changelog](https://next-changelog.malezjaa.tech/)
